groups.cause: PR #240 (ct-ogcq) classifies 8,510 format='other' WARC/ARC captures as record_role='envelope' (is_real_file=False). Across 48 veterans.house.gov/witness-testimony/* URLs (verified in base 453351a3a57b: all 48 lookup_keys with count=3 held `html:original` + `html:recovery` + `other:original`, e.g., `mr-james-binns`, `ted-h-wolf`, `joy-j-ilem-3`, `ned-m-hunter`, `arnold-russo`), removing the duplicate `other:original` envelope left a single `html:original` component at `original_url`, unblocking provenance-recovery-attachments.sql to attach each `html:recovery` row onto its original document (-48 rows).

groups.cause: PR #240 (ct-ogcq) classifies 8,510 format='other' WARC/ARC captures as record_role='envelope' (is_real_file=False). Of the 8,510 envelopes, 8,490 have no surviving link_key and leave detail.parquet/list.parquet (7,661 duplicate rows whose unwrapped capture_index=0 payload siblings are already published at the exact same URL, e.g. `0013b5a771987954` `fc-34act.htm`, `0017946a955a634a` `Pages_from_Michael_Petit_Witness_Disclosure_.pdf`; plus 829 non-document listing/wrapper shells with no recoveries, e.g. `0001bca03ce7309f` `james-l-hoff-dba`). The remaining 20 had rec_len=1 recoveries and promoted in place (-8,490 - 48 = -8,538 delta).
